verdict.rationale: Jules's core workflow is driven by natural-language task descriptions and messages: users submit a task in plain English, Jules generates a plan, and you can send further messages to the agent to steer it (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-12), with community users confirming they 'code' via casual task descriptions from their phone (jules-comm-12). Missing for 10: no evidence of rich conversational back-and-forth beyond simple messages/plan approval, and community reports note it sometimes needs heavy babysitting or gets stuck (jules-comm-15, jules-comm-18), suggesting NL command handling is imperfect on complex tasks.
